title: General Rodent Tattoo System
summary: Permanent tail identification for weanling and adult mice and rats.
description: A complete laboratory system for marking rodent tails with identification numbers, letters or lines. The kit combines tattoo equipment, pigments, needles and animal restraints. Equipment instructions and an adult rodent training guide accompany the system. Existing ATS-3 equipment can be extended with the NEO-AP or LLA-AP packages.
features: Tail identification for laboratory mice and rats
Two upgrade packages for existing ATS-3 equipment
specifications: Weanling to adult mice and rats
Equipment instructions and adult rodent tattoo guide

title: Neonate Rodent Tattooing System
summary: An identification system developed for newborn mice and rats from P0 to P15.
description: The NEO-9 supports individual identification during the neonatal period, including animals in transgenic breeding colonies. The system includes a micro tattooing station with LED illumination and magnification, together with equipment and neonate training instructions. The manufacturer describes identification sites on toes, paw pads, leg shanks and tails.
features: Neonate identification guide and ID schemes

title: Large Lab Animal Tattoo System
summary: Compact tattoo equipment for skin identification on larger laboratory animals.
description: The ATS-3L is designed for animals such as rabbits, guinea pigs, ferrets, nonhuman primates and swine. Its compact arrangement and lightweight tattoo machine support work in limited spaces. Identification can be placed on skin sites including ears, chest and inner limbs; treatment sites can also be marked. Operating instructions and a large-animal tattoo training guide accompany the system.
features: Equipment instructions and large-animal training guide
